name: deja-vu-ci
description: Déjà-vu CI — build failures with memory (Codegeist 2026, Atlassian Forge)

scripts.build: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/bridge && tsc -p packages/present
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core --noEmit && tsc -p packages/bridge --noEmit && tsc -p packages/present --noEmit
scripts.gen:data: node tools/gen/sample.mjs && node tools/gen/corpus.mjs && npm run check:data --silent
scripts.typecheck:apps: npm --prefix apps/sensor run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/brain run typecheck
